text:
Ana (PM): Quick sync — we're aiming to ship Quantization GA next sprint. Need signoff on SLA, docs, pricing, monitoring, and oncall runbook. Can owners confirm?
Mike (Eng): We ran perf across p50/p90/p99 for int8 and int4 on seq_len=512. p99 looks ~210ms for int8, ~240ms for int4. I propose SLO candidate = p99 <= 250ms for GA, with feature flag to opt into int4.
Ravi (ML): Accuracy tradeoff: int8 ~0.1% median drop, int4 ~0.7% on our eval set. We should include a quality-monitor gate before rollout.
Sara (Docs): I'll own the public GA docs + migration guide + changelog. Need list of known regressions and suggested prompt tweaks. ETA Wed EOD for draft.
James (Sales): Enterprise asks: SLA credit language and a rollback window (30 days) for customers switching to quantized models. Legal review needed? Also pricing: propose a 15% lower per-token for int8, 30% for int4. Thoughts?
Emily (Support): Support training + KB required. Need playbook for "bad decode" and customer rollback steps. Who writes the runbook?
Ana (PM): Assigning owners: Mike + Ravi for runbook + fallback behavior, Sara for external docs + KB, Emily for support training plan, James for pricing language + commercial ask.
Mike (Eng): One technical blocker: cold-start fallback can spike latency when KV cache miss happens. Proposed canary config below for staged rollout:
```json
{
  "canary": true,
  "traffic_split": {"canary": 0.05, "stable": 0.95},
  "max_p99_latency_ms": 300,
  "fallback_strategy": "route-to-stable-on-violations",
  "monitoring_hooks": ["p50","p90","p99","error_rate","quality_drift"]
}
```
Ravi (ML): Monitoring requirements: add daily eval job comparing sampled production responses to gold set; if accuracy drift > 1% rollback. Also emit per-model quantization tag to telemetry so we can segment metrics.
deploy-bot: Canary started on quantize-canary at 5201234590 — 5% traffic.
Sara (Docs): Docs checklist: migration guide, changelog, pricing FAQ, SLA appendix, known regressions + mitigation steps, KB article 'reverting quantized models'. I'll open a PR and link it here.
James (Sales): +1 on pricing tiers. Will draft recommended commercial language and run it by legal — pinging Legal in next hour.
Emily (Support): I'll schedule a 45m training slot next Tue and draft the runbook steps once Mike/Ravi share the fallback playbook.
Ana (PM): Decision needed by EOD Friday (5201234680). If no major objections we move from canary -> graduated canary (20%) Monday. Callout: SLO for GA = p99 <= 250ms, SLA credits TBD by Legal.
Mike (Eng): +1
Ravi (ML): noted
Sara (Docs): will have PR by Wed
James (Sales): will follow up with legal
Emily (Support): 👍
Ana (PM): Thanks everyone — adding action items to the tracker and will follow up on outstanding legal/pricing items.
